# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.4 D3 colonisation framework (phase 1, resettlement). Generated by gen_colonization.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# 2026-11-19 v6.6 D3 phase 2 (foreign settlers: events 3, 11, 12, 14; the discount interface oe_col_offer_discount) added to this file by the same generator.
# 2026-11-19 v6.6 D3 phase 3 (the Black Sea trading posts: events 20-24, the actions oe_col_open_post and oe_col_close_post, the building oe_col_emporion) added to this file by the same generator.
# 2026-11-20 v6.7 D3 phase 4a (the Roman colonia: oe_col_found_colonia, events 30-31) added to this file by the same generator.

# Any scope. The population (thousands) under which old Roman land counts as sparse.
oe_col_sparse_pop = {
    value = 6
}

# BYZ scope. Gold of an internal move: one month of tax and trade income (oe_fin_month); half while the discount lasts (oe_col_offer_discount).
oe_col_cost_in = {
    value = oe_fin_month
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_discount } multiply = 0.5 }
}

# BYZ scope. Gold of foreign soldier families: three months of income; half while the discount lasts.
oe_col_cost_out = {
    value = oe_fin_month
    multiply = 3
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_discount } multiply = 0.5 }
}

# BYZ scope. Half a month of income (oe_col.10 c).
oe_col_cost_half = {
    value = oe_fin_month
    multiply = 0.5
}

# BYZ scope. Two months of income (the AI keeps this much).
oe_col_m2 = {
    value = oe_fin_month
    multiply = 2
}

# BYZ scope. Four months of income.
oe_col_m4 = {
    value = oe_fin_month
    multiply = 4
}

# BYZ scope. The AI resettles only with this much gold: 6 months of income, at least 300.
oe_col_ai_gold = {
    value = oe_fin_month
    multiply = 6
    min = 300
}

# Province scope (the source). Thousands of people moved a month: population x 0.0005, within 0.03-0.12.
oe_col_mig_amount = {
    value = population
    multiply = 0.0005
    min = 0.03
    max = 0.12
}

# Location scope. Order of the targets: reclaimed land first, then the least populous.
oe_col_pick_score = {
    value = 0
    subtract = population
    if = { limit = { oe_col_reclaimed = yes } add = 1000 }
}

# Location scope. The least populous first.
oe_col_low_pop = {
    value = 0
    subtract = population
}

# BYZ scope. Sparse locations (readout, action description).
oe_col_sparse_n = {
    value = 0
    every_owned_location = { limit = { oe_col_sparse = yes } add = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. Migration slots in use (0-2).
oe_col_slots_used = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_loc } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_loc } add = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. Locations waiting for a quarrel (oe_col.2).
oe_col_dsp_n = {
    value = 0
    every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_dsp } add = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. 1 while the action is cooling down.
oe_col_act_cd_v = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_act_cd } value = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. One month of income, never discounted (oe_col.14 b).
oe_col_m1 = {
    value = oe_fin_month
}

# BYZ scope. 1 while L5's discount lasts (readout).
oe_col_disc_v = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_discount } value = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. Places where 'the soldiers' sons' may come (readout).
oe_col_sons_n = {
    value = 0
    every_owned_location = { limit = { oe_col_sons_ready = yes } add = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. Places of ours where foreign soldier families were settled (oe_col_kind = 2; readout).
oe_col_foreign_n = {
    value = 0
    every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_col_kind ?= 2 } add = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. Gold of a new trading post: 3 months of tax and trade income.

    value = oe_fin_month
    multiply = 3

    multiply = 4

# BYZ scope. Six months of income.
oe_col_m6 = {
    value = oe_fin_month
    multiply = 6

# BYZ scope. The AI asks for a post only with this much gold: 8 months of income, at least 300.
oe_col_post_ai_gold = {
    value = oe_fin_month
    multiply = 8
    min = 300
}

# Location scope (a site). The chance in percent that its owner admits a Roman post (design 3.5.2): 50, the owner's opinion of us (-30 to +30 in steps), Orthodox +15, on Genoa's side (D1's tier - 2) x 20, Trebizond after 'common cause' (oe_tre_genoa = 2) +10, Varna with C5's oe_nb_ports +10; within 10-90.
oe_col_host_ch = {
    value = 20
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= -75 } } } add = 8 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= -50 } } } add = 7 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= -25 } } } add = 7 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 0 } } } add = 8 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 25 } } } add = 8 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 50 } } } add = 7 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 75 } } } add = 7 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 100 } } } add = 8 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { religion = religion:orthodox } } add = 15 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } } add = -40 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } c:BYZ = { oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = gen n = 1 } } } add = 20 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } c:BYZ = { oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = gen n = 2 } } } add = 20 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } c:BYZ = { oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = gen n = 3 } } } add = 20 }
    if = {
        limit = { this = location:trebizond owner ?= c:TRE country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { var:oe_tre_genoa ?= 2 } }
        add = 10
    }
    if = { limit = { this = location:varna has_global_variable = oe_nb_ports } add = 10 }
    if = { limit = { owner ?= { has_variable = oe_cmp_prot } } add = 20 }
    min = 10
    max = 90
}

        add = 20
    }
    if = { limit = { location:alexandria = { owner ?= { has_variable = oe_cmp_prot } } } add = 20 }
    min = 10
    max = 90
}

# Any scope. oe_col_host_ch for beirut (readouts).
oe_col_ch_beirut = {
    value = 20
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= -75 } } } } add = 8 }
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= -50 } } } } add = 7 }
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= -25 } } } } add = 7 }
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 0 } } } } add = 8 }
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 25 } } } } add = 8 }
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 50 } } } } add = 7 }
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 75 } } } } add = 7 }
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 100 } } } } add = 8 }
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { owner ?= { religion = religion:orthodox } } } add = 15 }
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } } } add = -40 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            location:beirut = { owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } }
            c:BYZ = { oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = gen n = 1 } }
        }
        add = 20
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            location:beirut = { owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } }
            c:BYZ = { oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = gen n = 2 } }
        }
        add = 20
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            location:beirut = { owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } }
            c:BYZ = { oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = gen n = 3 } }
        }
        add = 20
    }
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { owner ?= { has_variable = oe_cmp_prot } } } add = 20 }
    min = 10
    max = 90
}

# Location scope. Months since the post here opened.
oe_col_since_m = {
    value = oe_ml_month_now
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_since } subtract = var:oe_col_post_since }
}

# Location scope. The order in which the post here was opened (the newest closes first when the upkeep cannot be paid).
oe_col_seq_v = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post_seq } add = var:oe_col_post_seq }
}

# Location scope. The AI's order of sites: the likeliest host first; a grain port (Varna, Kilia, Caffa, Tana) +25 while the grain road is tight.
oe_col_ai_site_score = {
    value = oe_col_host_ch
    if = {
        limit = {
            c:BYZ = { oe_col_grain_tight = yes }
            OR = { this = location:tana this = location:kaffa this = location:varna this = location:chilia }
        }
        add = 25
    }
}

# Any scope. Posts on foreign soil, suspended ones too (the cap; our own ports are not counted).
oe_col_posts_open_n = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { location:tana = { has_variable = oe_col_post NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_own } } }
        add = 1
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:kaffa = { has_variable = oe_col_post NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_own } } }
        add = 1
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:trebizond = { has_variable = oe_col_post NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_own } } }
        add = 1
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:sinop = { has_variable = oe_col_post NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_own } } }
        add = 1
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:varna = { has_variable = oe_col_post NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_own } } }
        add = 1
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:chilia = { has_variable = oe_col_post NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_own } } }
        add = 1
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:famagusta = { has_variable = oe_col_post NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_own } } }
        add = 1
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:alexandria = { has_variable = oe_col_post NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_own } } }
        add = 1
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:beirut = { has_variable = oe_col_post NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_own } } }
        add = 1
    }
}

# Any scope. Points that pay upkeep (level 1 = 1, level 2 = 2; not suspended, not our own ports).
oe_col_upkeep_pts = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { location:tana = { oe_col_post_pays = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:tana = { oe_col_post_pays = yes var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:kaffa = { oe_col_post_pays = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:kaffa = { oe_col_post_pays = yes var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:trebizond = { oe_col_post_pays = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:trebizond = { oe_col_post_pays = yes var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:sinop = { oe_col_post_pays = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:sinop = { oe_col_post_pays = yes var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:varna = { oe_col_post_pays = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:varna = { oe_col_post_pays = yes var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:chilia = { oe_col_post_pays = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:chilia = { oe_col_post_pays = yes var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:famagusta = { oe_col_post_pays = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:famagusta = { oe_col_post_pays = yes var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:alexandria = { oe_col_post_pays = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:alexandria = { oe_col_post_pays = yes var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { oe_col_post_pays = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { oe_col_post_pays = yes var:oe_col_post ?= 2 } } add = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. The yearly upkeep of the posts: 0.5 of a month of income a point.
oe_col_upkeep = {
    value = oe_col_upkeep_pts
    multiply = oe_fin_month
    multiply = 0.5
}

# BYZ scope. Half of the gold paid for the request under way.
oe_col_req_refund = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_req_paid } add = var:oe_col_req_paid multiply = 0.5 }
}

# BYZ scope. 1 while the opening voucher lasts (readout).
oe_col_voucher_v = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_voucher } value = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. 1 once the action 'Open a Trading Post' is open (readout).
oe_col_open_v = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c_open } value = 1 }
}

# BYZ scope. 1 while a request waits for its answer (readout).
oe_col_req_v = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_req_loc } value = 1 }
}

    if = { limit = { location:kaffa = { oe_col_has_emporion = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:trebizond = { oe_col_has_emporion = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:sinop = { oe_col_has_emporion = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:varna = { oe_col_has_emporion = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:chilia = { oe_col_has_emporion = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:famagusta = { oe_col_has_emporion = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:alexandria = { oe_col_has_emporion = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { location:beirut = { oe_col_has_emporion = yes } } add = 1 }
}
